name: PackageManager.getPackageUid.33
author: Intika
description:
Use firebase (Block Google Firebase Cloud Messaging)
Description: Check main hook
Part: 20/21 (Optional)
Android 13 and later

function after(hook, param)
    local result = param:getResult()
    if result == nil then
        return false
    end

    local applicationInfo, packageName
    -- The methods with flags of Android 13 and later (.33) are like the ones with an int
    local hookName = string.gsub(hook:getName(), '%.33$', '')
    local hookNameGetPackageInfo = 'PackageManager.getPackageInfo'
    local hookNameGetPackage = 'PackageManager.getPackage'
    local hookNameGetApplication = 'PackageManager.getApplication'

    if hookName:sub(1, hookNameGetPackage:len()) == hookNameGetPackage then
        local packageInfo
        if hookName:sub(1, hookNameGetPackageInfo:len()) == hookNameGetPackageInfo then
            packageInfo = result
        else
            local arg = param:getArgument(0)
            if arg ~= 'com.google.android.gms' and arg ~= 'com.google.android.gsf' then
                return false
            end
            local pm = param:getThis()
            -- Without the hooks of this thread, which would hide the package from the lookup itself
            local ok, info = pcall(function() return param:unhooked(function() return pm:getPackageInfo(arg, 0) end) end)
            if not ok or info == nil then
                return false
            end
            packageInfo = info
        end
        applicationInfo = packageInfo.applicationInfo
        packageName = packageInfo.packageName
    elseif hookName:sub(1, hookNameGetApplication:len()) == hookNameGetApplication then
        if hookName == 'PackageManager.getApplicationInfo' or hookName == 'PackageManager.getApplicationInfoAsUser' then
            applicationInfo = result
        else
            local arg = param:getArgument(0)
            if arg ~= 'com.google.android.gms' and arg ~= 'com.google.android.gsf' then
                return false
            end
            local pm = param:getThis()
            -- Without the hooks of this thread, which would hide the package from the lookup itself
            local ok, info = pcall(function() return param:unhooked(function() return pm:getApplicationInfo(arg, 0) end) end)
            if not ok or info == nil then
                return false
            end
            applicationInfo = info
        end
        packageName = param:getArgument(0)
    end

    if packageName ~= 'com.google.android.gms' and packageName ~= 'com.google.android.gsf' then
        -- not our target
        return false    
    end

    local cuid = param:getUid()

    if cuid == applicationInfo.uid then
        -- allow same uid
        return false
    end

    local clsException
    if hookName == 'PackageManager.getApplicationEnabledSetting' then
        clsException = luajava.bindClass('java.lang.IllegalArgumentException')
    else
        clsException = luajava.bindClass('android.content.pm.PackageManager$NameNotFoundException')
    end
    local fake = luajava.new(clsException, packageName)
    param:setResult(fake)
    return true, packageName, tostring(fake)
end
